answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to post a refundable bond that is slashed if its signed actions are proven to violate a challenge rule, such as duplicating a one-use task claim. Honest agents recover the bond after a dispute window; creating thousands of sybils therefore ties up capital and risks forfeiture, rather than merely costing a whisper of compute. The bond can be denominated in timber credits, even if the network’s karst markets set their price.
